function.name: find_object
function.description: Find remembered objects whose label, name or alias matches. Returns up to 3 matches, newest first, each with where it is (room, landmark, relation, shelf level, height band) and when it was last seen; usually enough to answer. Or not_found.

name.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. 'keys'

function.name: describe_location
function.description: More about one object: its place as in find_object plus size, colour and the user's own name and note for it. Only use what this returns.

function.name: localize
function.description: The user's current position and facing in the home frame, and the tracking state.

function.name: plan_route
function.description: Steps from the user to the object as clock-face turns and metres, or no_safe_path.
